reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: I loved this app for a couple years actually. For the last month or so, every time I open the app and try to access my family calendar or meal plan, it repeatedly bumps me back to the main menu. At first it was just once a day, then they did an app update and now it’s every time I try to use the app. I pay for the premium version too, and I’m about to cancel it because it’s plain annoying when I’m trying to quickly access my calendar when scheduling appointments.

reviews.title: Keeps crashing
reviews.text:
We’ve used this app for lists and groceries for years with no issues. For the past ~2 weeks or so, the app crashes more than it works. The list app for groceries used to remain open for the entirety of my shopping trip. Now once my phone goes to sleep, the app returns to the main menu when I unlock it again. Then when I click on lists it crashes a few times back to the main menu before allowing me to resume viewing my list. It makes shopping and making the grocery list more difficult than it needs to be. This also applies to the calendar feature. It crashes back to the app’s main menu before being able to add or edit your events. The key features my family uses this app for are not functioning optimally at this time.

There need to be fixes for these bugs immediately.

reviews.title: Still a newbie but
reviews.text: Just paid for this to get the premium features and yeh looks good, a lot of different options. Couple of basic things though as the main app is the calendar which is very poor and no different to google calendar and time tree. When you add an event you can choose a colour but you can’t give each colour a category apart from 4 default ones. Eg concerts you can choose a colour for one event but then have to remember every time you have chosen that colour next time you add an concert event. Secondly when you add an event, in month review the event is a very thin strip barely readable rather than taking up the whole date which would make more sense and make the whole month view much better. I am a newbie so hope these basics are amendable
